tool.name: BinSPreader
tool.description: refine and propagate a metagenomic binning using the assembly graph
tool.command: @TOOL_BINARY@ '$graph' '$binning' 'output' --tmp-dir binspreader_tmp -t "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" #if str($binning_format) == 'cami' --cami #end if #if str($reads.use_reads) == 'yes' --dataset '$dataset_yaml' #if str($reads.split_reads) == 'true' -r --bin-weight $reads.bin_weight #end if #end if #if $advanced.bin_dist --bin-dist #end if #if $advanced.zero_bin --zero-bin #end if #if $advanced.tall_multi --tall-multi #end if #if $advanced.no_unbinned_bin --no-unbinned-bin #end if #if $advanced.multiple_assignment -m #end if #if str($advanced.assignment_strategy) $advanced.assignment_strategy #end if #if str($advanced.refiner_type) $advanced.refiner_type #end if #if str($advanced.iterations) -n $advanced.iterations #end if #if str($advanced.epsilon) -e $advanced.epsilon #end if #if $advanced.sparse_propagation --sparse-propagation #if str($advanced.metaalpha) -ma $advanced.metaalpha #end if #if str($advanced.length_threshold) -lt $advanced.length_threshold #end if #if str($advanced.distance_bound) -db $advanced.distance_bound #end if #end if

configfiles.configfile: #if str($reads.use_reads) == 'yes' #set $left_reads = ", ".join(['"%s"' % $read for $read in $reads.left_reads]) #set $right_reads = ", ".join(['"%s"' % $read for $read in $reads.right_reads]) [ { orientation: "$reads.orientation", type: "$reads.library_type", left reads: [$left_reads], right reads: [$right_reads] } ] #end if

param.name: graph
param.label: Assembly graph in GFA 1.0 format
param.help: The graph must contain path lines (P records) describing the scaffolds, e.g. the assembly_graph_with_scaffolds.gfa file of SPAdes 3.16 or older. SPAdes 4.x writes GFA 1.2, which is not supported.

param.name: binning
param.label: Initial binning
param.help: A two-column table with contig names and bin names, e.g. the output of MetaBAT2, MaxBin2 or COMEBin. The contig names must match the scaffold names of the graph.

param.name: binning_format
param.label: Binning format of the input and the output
param.help: CAMI bioboxes format is written by some binners and binning evaluation tools; select it if your input file contains the CAMI header lines.

param.name: use_reads
param.label: Use read libraries
param.help: Reads are mapped to the assembly graph and the resulting links are used as additional connectivity information.

param.name: split_reads
param.label: Split reads according to the refined binning
param.help: Writes the reads assigned to each bin as separate FASTQ files.

param.label: Read bin weight threshold
param.help: Only reads with a bin weight above this threshold are assigned to a bin when splitting reads.

param.label: Estimate pairwise bin distances
param.help: Writes a matrix of pairwise bin distances. This can be slow on large graphs.

param.label: Report a zero bin for unbinned sequences
Write multiple binning assignments in tall table format
Do not create a bin for unbinned contigs

param.name: multiple_assignment
param.label: Allow a contig to be assigned to several bins
param.help: Contigs belonging to several MAGs (e.g. repeats) are assigned to all of them.

param.name: assignment_strategy
param.label: Binning assignment strategy
param.help: Maximum likelihood based assignment strategy used to resolve conflicting bin assignments.

param.name: iterations
param.label: Maximum number of iterations
param.help: Leave empty to use the tool default.

param.name: epsilon
param.label: Convergence relative tolerance threshold
param.help: Leave empty to use the tool default.

param.label: Gradually reduce alpha from binned to unbinned contigs

param.name: metaalpha
param.label: Labels correction alpha for sparse propagation
param.help: Only used with sparse propagation. Leave empty to use the tool default.

param.name: length_threshold
param.label: Length threshold for sparse propagation
param.help: The binning is not propagated to contigs longer than this threshold. Only used with sparse propagation.

param.name: distance_bound
param.label: Distance bound for sparse propagation
param.help: The binning is not propagated further than this bound. Only used with sparse propagation.

tool.help:
**BinSPreader**
BinSPreader refines and propagates an existing metagenomic binning (a set of MAGs) using the connectivity of the assembly graph and, optionally, of paired-end or Hi-C read libraries. The assembly graph is used to
- correct binning errors, - propagate the binning from longer contigs to shorter contigs connected to them, - assign contigs that belong to several MAGs (e.g. repeats) to all of them.
Reads are mapped to the graph and the resulting links are used as an additional source of connectivity information.
-----
**Input**
- **Assembly graph in GFA 1.0 format**: a graph with path lines (`P` records) that describe the scaffolds, e.g. the `assembly_graph_with_scaffolds.gfa` file produced by SPAdes 3.16 or older. SPAdes 4.x writes GFA 1.2, which is not supported. The scaffold paths are taken from the graph; a separate contig paths file is not supported. - **Initial binning**: a two-column table with contig names and bin names, as produced by binning tools such as MetaBAT2, MaxBin2 or COMEBin. The contig names must match the scaffold names of the graph. For a graph written by SPAdes, the `P` record names are the contig names with an additional `_<index>` suffix (`NODE_1_length_1000_cov_10.5_1`); the tool drops this last field, so the binning must use the contig names of the SPAdes contigs file (`NODE_1_length_1000_cov_10.5`). - **Read libraries** (optional): paired-end or Hi-C reads. The reads are mapped to the graph, and their links are used as additional connectivity information. Reads can also be split into separate FASTQ files per bin, which is useful for e.g. reassembly of the refined MAGs.
-----
**Output**
- **Refined binning**: the binning after refinement and propagation. Contigs that remain unbinned are reported in the `unbinned` bin unless *Do not create a bin for unbinned contigs* is set. In CAMI bioboxes format when the CAMI format is selected. - **Bin statistics**: coverage and length statistics of every bin before and after refinement. - **Bin weights**: for every scaffold, the weights of the bins it was assigned to. - **Edge weights**: for every graph edge, its length, coverage and bin weights. - **Pairwise bin distances** (optional): a matrix of distances between bins. - **Reads split by bin** (optional): one FASTQ file per bin and read mate, plus the unbinned reads, when *Split reads* is selected.
-----
**Notes**
- Refinement uses the graph structure only unless read libraries are given. - The tool creates a scratch directory (`--tmp-dir`) that must not exist; the wrapper takes care of this.
